New snapshot-pinned apt mirror: public `GET /snap/<T>/<archive>/dists|pool/...` routes serve Debian index sets frozen verbatim at a cut timestamp (upstream signatures intact) plus a shared read-through R2 pool cache (live archive first, snapshot.debian.org at `T` for superseded files, permanent caching), and admin `POST /apt-mirror/cut` / `POST /apt-mirror/warm` routes freeze a new timestamp and pre-fetch its pool under a re-runnable time budget. All routes answer 503 until the `APT_MIRROR_*` env configuration (see `.minds/template/apt-mirror.sh`) is present.
